title: World Cup Golf: Professional Edition
overview:
World Cup Golf is one of the most playable, most realistic and most visually impressive golf simulations.

The game has been given an interface that offers the newcomer the best overview of all features, while giving the experienced player complete control to adapt them to their own wishes.

These include, among other things, shot variations with spin, topspin or backspin, as well as the option of reshaping the entire World Cup tournament according to your own rules.
